scope: Read-only review of the Traditional Chinese boundary fix in scripts/question-position-validation.ts and its tests. The separate prompt-cache native wording work is assessed only as an unmerged follow-up.

incidentEvidence.failure: validation-error.txt records aif-c01-d3-03-005/zh-TW.choices[0].explanation rejected as position-dependent text.
incidentEvidence.cause: The earlier broad next-question match treated the substring 次問 inside the legitimate Traditional Chinese compound 每次問題 as a Japanese adjacent-question reference.
incidentEvidence.sourceHashBoundary: The affected prompt-cache input records sourceHash f80c1a09b0902021b5bea527f502154b93f8ccdd893fcbf22c05c6c142ac8697, revision 1, and correct choice D; this review did not mutate source, cache, or translation data.

implementationAssessment.finalRule: scripts/question-position-validation.ts:5 uses (?<!每)次問|(?<!目)前問, alongside the existing choice-letter and locale-specific checks.
implementationAssessment.whyCorrect: The negative lookbehinds suppress only 次問 in 每次問題 and 前問 in 目前問題. They retain rejection of Japanese 次問, 前問, and 次問題, instead of weakening the complete position-reference rule.
implementationAssessment.rejectedAlternative: The initial (?!題) suffix approach would have allowed Japanese 次問題. It was correctly not retained.
implementationAssessment.noBypass: The validation rule remains active for every recursively visited string field; no source, locale, or path exclusion was introduced.

regressionEvidence: scripts/question-position-validation.test.ts:7-19 rejects 次問, 前問, 次問題, choice-letter references, English adjacent-question references, and localized choice-letter references.
scripts/question-position-validation.test.ts:21-34 accepts only the required Traditional Chinese compounds 每次問題 and 目前問題, including recursive choice explanation traversal.
Independent runtime probe confirmed those two accepted strings and all four required Japanese/choice-reference strings rejected.
output/question-quality/position-tw-boundary-red.log preserves the real RED failure; output/question-quality/position-tw-boundary-green.log passes all 3 tests and 15 assertions.

promptCacheFollowUp.assessment: The current source for aif-c01-d3-03-005 has revision 1, correct D, and explains that putting a changing question inside the policy prevents the whole policy from remaining a common prefix. A bounded wording clarification to choice B explanation and learning material across 18 locale fields is semantically appropriate only if it preserves that condition, correct D, revision, and all other fields. It is not a necessary change for the position-boundary fix and must be independently reviewed after application.
